sources.title: Historical Basemaps: imported world snapshots
sources.note: Data identification only. Locally decoded world-1800 Bundelkhand polygon excludes the core region and instead spans northern/eastern India and Bangladesh. Point tests and the overview’s geometry warning are original packet calculations; overviewSourceIds cite historical framing, not external authorship of those measurements. No corrected polygon or replacement polity is inferred.

sources.title: District Jalaun, Brief History of the District
sources.note: Official district account: Chhatrasal rebellion1671, Maratha alliance, Kalpi transfer1806, later exports. Do not adopt erroneous Chhatrasal death1732, sweeping claim of Maratha annexation of every state, or colonial stereotypes about anarchy causing modern poverty.

sources.title: District Banda, History
sources.note: Use narrowly for British occupation of Kalinjar1812 and district headquarters1819. Its Bassein treaty date1803 is erroneous and is not adopted.

sources.title: Imperial Gazetteer of India, volume24, United Provinces history (1908)
sources.note: Original colonial reference work, United Provinces historical account, Peshwa cession1817 and subsequent administrative incorporations. Direct indexed original passage checked. Do not adopt justification of colonial conquest or a single end for all Bundelkhand states.

sources.title: Archaeological Survey of India, The historic ensemble of Orchha (2019)
sources.note: Indian Tentative List submission hosted by UNESCO, not an inscription on the World Heritage List. Description/criteria: capital1531 to 1783, palace courtyards, gardens, living community maintenance.

sources.title: Royal Asiatic Society, Papers of Alexander Gerard, GB891AG
sources.note: Catalogue scope and content:23-page handwritten history of Bundelkhand in1803, presented3May1828; genealogies and annual revenue statements. Gerard was not in India in1803. Catalogue examined, manuscript itself not examined.

sources.title: IGNCA, Bundelkhand cultural collection: everyday life
sources.note: Modern Hindi cultural account, sections on household/festival practices, foods and children’s games; no exact observation dates or proof of universal1800 practice. Group all coilnet/bund chapters as one work conservatively. Do not reproduce essentialist claims or untested statements about scientific efficacy.

sources.title: IGNCA, Bundeli poetry in historical context
sources.note: Modern Hindi transcription explicitly prints रसिकप्रिया among Keshav’s works, in रीति भक्ति काव्य discussion. This is a modern spelling witness, not a facsimile of a1591 manuscript. Group with all Bundelkhand coilnet chapters.

sources.title: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art, Rasikapriya glossary
sources.note: Indexed original glossary checked: title translated Connoisseur’s Delights, poetics manual by Keshav Das1591. Direct open intermittently errors; search original reproduces full glossary.

sources.title: LACMA, Krishna and Radha Meeting, Rasikapriya folio, M.71.1.12
sources.note: Direct collection record:1634, Orchha(?) attribution explicitly uncertain, opaque watercolor/gold/ink on paper, image10.8x13.65cm.

sources.title: J. F. Blumhardt, Catalogue of Hindi, Panjabi and Hindustani manuscripts (1899)
sources.note: Printed26 to 27/PDF41 to 42, no. 43, Add. 5578, Rasikapriya: eighteenth-century copy on J.Whatman paper, Braj verse, composition1591,16chapters. Printed30/PDF45 no47 separately18th-century. OCR original-script passages corrupted and PDF screenshots unavailable: do not transcribe those from OCR. Other outdated biographical dates not used.

sources.title: National Institute of Disaster Management, Bundelkhand Drought (2014)
sources.note: Printed66/PDF80 water systems, stairways and orchards; printed34/PDF48 women/water account, later family work and school effects. Do not universalize gender stereotypes in the quoted report.

sources.title: Traditional Rainwater Management (Haveli cultivation) for Building System Level Resilience (2022)
sources.note: Primary ICRISAT/consortium study. Introduction and Material/Methods: historical300 to 500-year attribution, earthen embankments, communal maintenance, monsoon-to-crop conversion. Figure2 modern before/after field photographs. No exactyear assigned to origin.

sources.title: Raj Kumar Verma, Livestock healthcare plants in Tikamgarh (2014)
sources.note: Original full indexed article checked, direct PMC sometimes CAPTCHA. July2011 to June2012 interviews, plant identification/vouchers;41species. Ethnobotanical documentation does not test clinical effectiveness or prove1800 use.

sources.title: Friends of Orchha homestay, Eco-friendliness
sources.note: Local project’s primary description, Water conservation: baths through sand filter; two of six homes composting toilets; one buffalo household biogas digester. Contemporary undated page accessed2026; cannot backdate toBundela period or claim citywide adoption.

proposedOverrides.name: Bundelkhand
proposedOverrides.summary: Bundela states, Maratha interests and Company expansion in a region of palaces, poetry and reservoir farming.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Exact indexed record only,1800 to 1815. No aliases. Historical regional card kept separate from existing chandellas and maratha cards. Public overview explicitly rejects geometry as misplaced.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: One world-1800 polygon. Bbox76.1101611,20.9963927 to92.5983260,30.3663932. All tested core towns Jhansi/Orchha/Banda/Panna/Khajuraho/Kalinjar/Datia outside. Kolkata/Patna/Lucknow/Dhaka/Chittagong inside. Do not relabel as Bengal/Company/Awadh without verification; no repaired geometry supplied. Original network fetch blocked; local decoded imported geometry directly checked.
batchIdentityNotes.chronology: The1800snapshot extends to1815 mechanically. Sixteenth/seventeenth-century Bundela buildings/books and18thcentury alliances are background.1806Kalpi/1812Kalinjar directly relevant.1817cession/1819districtheadquarters later. Modern farming study separates traditional mechanics from presentfield observations;2011 to 2012healthcare/2014drought/undatedhomestay and folk descriptions explicitlylater.
batchIdentityNotes.writing: Rasikapriya1591composition. Exact Devanagari title from IGNCA modern transcription; Smithsonian translation; Braj designation/catalogue of18thcenturycopy from1899primarymuseumcatalogue. No facsimile of manuscript handwriting claimed. Original-script OCR in oldcatalogue is damaged and not used.
batchIdentityNotes.sourceLimits: IGNCA wholeBundelkhandcoilnetwork grouped conservatively. Historical district pages contain wrong dates and colonial stereotypes, selectively excluded. Modern local sanitation project is primary self-report, not citywide survey. Medicine limited to independently documented recent veterinary knowledge; no unsupported historic hospital orpalacetoilet claim.
